included_scope: Complete installed own portable converter core, resources, build metadata and synthetic core tests; optional external/native probe trees excluded.
limitations: No charts, OEM/native libraries, keys, licensed catalogs, firmware, original media, device captures or runtime/profile data are included.

Installed core is complete; source_snapshot and optional tools/original_query_probe, tools/navionics_native_probe and tools/rx5_source17_stream research/probe trees are intentionally outside this release.
Tests tied to omitted optional tools are excluded by explicit list in excluded-tests.json; the included tests use invented source fixtures.
Native S52 bridge needs the separately supplied public No5/OpenCPN source/assets and system compiler/GL/EGL dependencies; no native/device qualification is claimed.
Chart format experiments remain incomplete: synthetic wire/geometry checks do not establish a navigable plotter chart, device compatibility or rights to third-party inputs.
